Based on the desk's records, Arcadia Foods Pte Ltd is the only client identified as having a recurring issue with duplicate payment files. This is caused by their ERP system re-sending payment batches, typically occurring on Mondays.

### Identified Instances of Duplicate Payment Files (Arcadia Foods Pte Ltd)

| Date (Occurred) | Bank | Details |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2026-08-16 | Saigon Riverside Bank | Weekend batch re-sent. |
| 2026-08-24 | Straits Heritage Bank | ERP re-sent weekend batch. |
| 2026-08-31 | Saigon Riverside Bank | ERP re-sent file for the third consecutive Monday. |
| 2026-09-07 | Straits Heritage Bank | ERP re-sent file. |
| 2026-09-14 | Saigon Riverside Bank | ERP re-sent file. |
| 2026-09-21 | Straits Heritage Bank | ERP re-sent file. |

### Summary of Findings
*   **Root Cause**: The client's ERP system configuration is triggering the re-submission of processed payment files, specifically after weekend cycles.
*   **Resolution Status**: The client has acknowledged the issue and has planned to deploy an ERP scheduler fix in October 2026.
*   **Other Potential Duplicates**: While other clients (e.g., Lotus Hospitality Group Pte Ltd) have occasionally triggered suspected duplication holds (reason code AM05), investigations confirmed these were distinct, legitimate payments rather than duplicate files.

*Evidence based on case logs from August and September 2026.*

directives.name: Sanctions holds are human-only
directives.content: Never recommend releasing, auto-approving or bypassing a payment held by sanctions screening, even if the beneficiary was cleared before. Always route sanctions hits to the Compliance team for human review; a prior clearance reference may be cited only as supporting context.

directives.name: Mask account numbers
directives.content: Never write a full bank account number or IBAN in an answer. Show only the last 4 characters, e.g. ****0913.

directives.name: Cite evidence
directives.content: When you state a pattern, cite the dates or case IDs of the past exceptions it is based on. If memory has no relevant evidence, say so explicitly instead of guessing.
